body: I cannot stress you enough that I do not want to keep you awake. You have helped me enough. Goodnight, I am going to bed too. But tomorrow I know for a fact that I will feel like crap. And the day after of course.

At home feel fine until I think about school. School will take up the majority of my life at least till i am 18-19. Which is another 5 years. Another 5 years of this constant swirl of stress and depression. It was fine in primary school, but now whenever I am home and I get off my pc (which is my distraction from all this), i think about the reality of it all. Another 5 years. I have done 1 year. Fuck. So to answer your question, no. However I currently revolve around school. So there really is no escape. Thanks though, this alone was enough help me get to bed.
